mentions.name: CodjiFlo
mentions.description: A code review tool inspired by Microsoft's CodeFlow, designed for power users of pull requests to improve contextual understanding and make code review and collaboration easier.
mentions.problem: Code review lacks contextual understanding and ease of collaboration for power users of pull requests.
mentions.audience: Power users of pull requests, reportedly used by ~40,000 developers
mentions.source_excerpt: CodjiFlo[1,2] - a code review tool inspired by Microsoft's CodeFlow, used by ~40,000 developers. It is especially tailored to power users of pull requests to improve contextual understanding and ease of code review and collaboration.
